summary: Two Bedrooms · Prime Jesmond Location · Available August 2022
description: Acorn Properties are delighted to bring to the market this smartly presented two bedroom, first floor flat on Grosvenor Avenue, Jesmond. Located at the row end, the property's unique period styling brings a unique sense of charm and warmth. Originally a three bedroom flat the property benefits from a large bathroom formerly bedroom resulting in an equally spacious kitchen. A well presented large double bedroom accompanies a smaller, single bedroom which could be utilised as either a guest room or office space. Viewing is highly recommended- give Acorn properties a call today and speak to the Lettings Team.
